description: Ask Thunai evaluation corpus: real questions people ask a family jothidar (Tamil script, Tanglish, English). Each row lists the expected topic(s), the asker's age band, faith (when stated), whether it asks "when", and tags a good answer MUST / MUST NOT contain. Tags are defined in test/common-questions.test.js (CHECKS).
